label: SYNTHETIC students and simulated answers
world: A new SYNTHETIC option set of 30 homes per trial (prefs.syntheticWorld)

setup.truths: prior: true weights drawn from the prior. off-prior: vTime at 0.3x or 3x the prior median (alternating), vDark at the prior 95th percentile, others from the prior.
setup.answers: logit at tau x tauScale with the true weights; the posterior always assumes tau = 25
setup.policies: bald: max information gain each pick. random: a random pair from the same pool. fixed: the 6 highest-gain pairs under the prior, chosen before any answer.
setup.pool: every pair of homes (best room under the posterior mean) on the modal week, plus room pairs inside a home
setup.decision: recommend the room with the highest posterior-mean utility on the mean week; regret against the true best
setup.stopRule: stop at 6 picks, or after 3 when best IG < 0.05 nats or top P(best) >= 0.8 (modal week)

headline.text: Off-prior stress set, tau x1: mean regret over picks 1 to 6 is 23.4 $/month lower with BALD than with random pairs (95% bootstrap interval -30.1 to -16.7). Across the 6 settings BALD has clearly lower regret than random in 6, clearly higher in 0, and no clear difference in 0.
